aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Left unset, the output keeps the ratio of the person image.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

instruction.description: Optional. A complete product-holding instruction already runs; this is appended to it. Use it for which hand, which way the label faces, or what must stay untouched.
instruction.title: Instruction

seed.description: Random seed. The same seed with the same inputs returns the same image.
seed.title: Seed

sync_mode.description: Return the image inline in the response instead of as a hosted URL. Adds latency.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

product_image_urls.title: Product Image Urls
product_image_urls.description: One to three reference images of the product to place: extra angles, its packaging, or a companion item. They describe one holding scene rather than three separate products. The product's geometry, colors, materials, branding and label text are reproduced as given.

person_image_url.description: Photo of the person who will hold the product. Their identity, face, expression, clothing, pose and the background are preserved; only the arm and hand move.
person_image_url.title: Person Image Url

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name
